title: Micro-Improvement Project (MIP)
description: Mirrors the column structure of ShikshaLokam's 'Domain-wise Micro Improvements (MIs) Framework' (Shikshagraha Commons, resource 259), the de facto MIP plan format. Fields under 'x_transform' are additions made by this project and are not part of the source format. Size limits are taken from the catalogue: 99 MIPs, mostly 2 weeks to 1 month, with 5-7 tasks.

sub_category.description: Sub-category / Category column, e.g. 'Physical Infrastructure', 'Parent Engagement'

target_stakeholder.description: The MIP owner who executes it. In the catalogue: HM/HT/school leader (~60%), teachers (~27%), plus SMC, CRP, DIET/BEO. Never students; student roles go in task-level roles.

duration.description: Free text in the source ('2 weeks', '1 month'). Mode is 1 month; observed max is 2 months.

project_learning_resources.description: PROJECT LEVEL LEARNING RESOURCE (+ editable link). Often hosted on bodh.shikshalokam.org.

tasks.description: Ordered tasks. Catalogue observed: typically 5-7, max 12.

x_transform.description: Added by the transformer; not in the source format.

source_ref.description: Catalogue sheet + row or Commons resource id of the original MIP

variant_id.description: Assigned by the orchestrator, never by a model: 'v1:' + the first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of this MIP with x_transform.variant_id, parent_variant_id and pipeline removed (keys sorted, UTF-8, no whitespace). The same content always gets the same id.

parent_variant_id.description: variant_id of the baseline this variant was transformed from. Absent on baselines.

variant_kind.description: seed = authored by this project, not sourced

pipeline.description: What produced this variant, so outcomes can be traced to prompt and card versions

prompt_hashes.description: prompt file name -> first 12 hex chars of its SHA-256

pb_process.description: Card PB-scope: may the work be labelled participatory budgeting at all?

pb_prioritise.description: Card PB-prioritise: approval/ranked ballot on needs or options

pb_allocate.description: Card PB-allocate-knapsack: CONDITIONAL when the amount is unconfirmed

budget_capped_choice.description: Card PB-not-pb: knapsack reasoning without the PB label

evidence_based.description: Card EB-scope: Tier 1 evidence-based practices (optional for variants produced before this gate existed)

already_present.description: What the original already does that each framework values; must be filled before any additions are proposed

constraint.description: Only when a budget-capped choice applies

source.description: e.g. untied composite grant headroom, SMC-raised funds, CSR. Must be confirmed by the owner.

basis.description: Reference-card id or citation. Unsourced numbers are rejected.

attribution.description: Credit line for the original org and Shikshagraha Commons

condition.description: For CONDITIONAL: the question the MIP owner must answer, e.g. 'Is a discretionary amount confirmed, and how much?'

tier.description: Evidence-based gate only: 1 = Tier 1 practice, 2 = Tier 2 pilot

deferred.description: True if the gate applied but the transformer couldn't fit the method within the size limits (recorded as a follow-on idea)

principle.description: CL principle or PB technique this change serves

x_limits.description: Hard limits the critic enforces on a transformed MIP; the transformer suggests splitting into chained MIPs instead of exceeding them
x_limits.new_paid_inputs: only if the gate found a real, confirmed budget
